checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Lower hand supports head while upper hand holds the upper ankle.
checks.feet: Side lying torso stays stable; upper knee bends to bring heel toward glute and upper thigh stays nearly parallel to floor.
checks.movement: Lie on side, head supported by lower arm. Hold upper ankle behind body with knee bent and thigh parallel to floor. Keep abdomen engaged without arching. Eight-second maintained hold, entry and exit omitted; repeat opposite side after set.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative; lower only while keeping the back supported.
